Synopsis:
A dying man, part of Stone Lord's crew, lies on the ground dying. His crew have been attacked by the Guild while attempting to smuggle goods through the city.Players may approach the man, he will whisper his last words and takes his last breath.

Cluster Contexts:
- WYR_SmugglersCave_DyingAttacker.json: A wounded member of the Stone Lord’s crew lies dying after a clash with the Smugglers’ Guild while they tried to smuggle goods through the city; players can approach him as he bleeds out. He rasps a few last requests — notably to tell his boss and warn his comrades — then takes his final breath. Off‑screen Baldur’s Gate is already unstable (refugee strain, Flaming Fist presence, Gortash’s rise) and nearby story threads (Orin impersonations, Netherstone rumours, checkpoint dramas) may overlap with this brief encounter. Some variants of the beat hint at uncanny or deceptive forces at play, but the lines themselves only require that the man is dying and desperate to be heard.
- WYR_OrinsImpersonation_OrinDyingAttacker.json: The scene takes place in the Smuggler’s Cave amid a skirmish between the Smugglers’ Guild and forces aligned with the Stone Man: Eroll (the impaled man) is found pinned on a makeshift stake, pleading for aid and begging the player to help his comrades. Despite the player's attempts or offers to heal him, Eroll insists no cure will work and asks to be put out of his misery — then dies before your eyes. His anguished, oddly gleeful demeanor as he dies implies something uncanny or deceptive at work (the game’s assets link this beat to a wider “Orin impersonation” thread), but nothing in the exchange requires knowing exactly who — if anyone — is manipulating him.
